notice_linux_helper: Linux only. Install the privileged helper before starting the adapter. Private and preshared keys are encrypted by ioBroker.
local_networks_help: Networks behind this site. Configure these as AllowedIPs on the remote site.
remote_networks_help: Routes are created for every entry. Default routes are rejected.
local_public_key_help: Send this public key to the remote site. Never send the private key.
generate_keypair: Generate new private and public key
keypair_generated: The key pair was generated. Save the configuration to store the private key encrypted.
keypair_generation_failed: The key pair could not be generated.
keypair_not_authorized: Only an ioBroker Admin instance may generate a key pair.
replace_key_text: Generating a new key makes the previous public key invalid. The remote site must be updated.
endpoint_host_help: DNS name, IPv4 or IPv6 address without brackets.
auto_apply: Apply configuration when the adapter starts
